div.head: Norðleoda 12
div.ab: 7 gif hig þæt nabbað, ne to þam geþeon ne magan, gylde man cyrlisce.
Et si non habeant hoc nec ad id conscendant, componatur de eis sicut de cyrlisco.
And gif hi þæt nabbað, ne to ðam geþeon ne magon, gilde man cirlisce.
And gif hig þæt nabbað, ne to þam geþeon ne magan, gylde man cyrlisce.
And if they have it not, and cannot prosper sufficiently, one is to pay at the ceorl's rate.
And if they do not have it and cannot acquire enough, their compensation will be that of a commoner.
Und wenn sie jenes [Land] nicht besitzen, noch dazu emporkommen können, entgelte man [sie nur als] gemeinfrei.
And if they do not have that [land] and cannot rise to it, let them be paid for [only] as ceorls.
div.note: Ld lacks this clause (perhaps as a mere repetition of 10), as does the first edition of the Quadripartitus. In H, Wif follows; in D, ‘Be Mircna laga’.
